I've written the round 110 task. **Decision: CONTINUE.** No app source was changed; `git status` in `store/` is still empty.

**Round 109 result (from C and the gate, not from A's claims):** C passed every row with a real browser (browserVerified and realVerified both true). The gate published it as commit `1fe3ba2`, so that is the new baseline.
- **Done:** C-R23-01, C-R38-01 and GATE108-S4.
- **Still open:** PROD-SSR-NUL. Nobody has measured the production-build HTML yet, so it stays as an open gate / Tech Lead check.
- **New Lows, moved to `deferred_low_polish`:**
  - C-R109-OBS-01: with JavaScript disabled, `/studio-lab` is black. It was already like this before round 109.
  - GATE109-F3: the `biome-ignore` comment in the new test.
- **Ownership:** `entry.server.tsx` and `app/lib/ssr/` were granted on my reading of your 2026-10-23 decision. Root published them, so I've recorded the grant as accepted in practice. Plan §6 now marks both as frozen again.

**Why round 110 is not the regression round:** the last regression was 2026-10-21 and today is 2026-10-23, so the 3-day rule isn't met. The next planning on or after 2026-10-24 will be the regression round.

**Round 110 (D-29z75): B-R108-LIB-FOCUS-LOSS (Medium).** I re-checked it in real Chromium at `1fe3ba2`. The library's ◀ collapse, ▶ expand and × search-clear buttons each disappear when pressed, focus drops to the page body, and the next Enter adds a clip.
- **The fix:**
  - Focus passes to the button's partner: ◀ to ▶, ▶ to ◀, and × to the search box.
  - Focus moves only if the button had focus and nothing else has taken it since.
  - When the video opens or closes the library, focus does not move.
- **Held-Enter guard:** Enter repeats are blocked on all three buttons. This is required: without it, holding Enter would flip ◀ and ▶ back and forth.
- **A's files:** a narrow part of `ArrangementLibrary.tsx`, a new `library-focus-handoff.test.tsx`, a new doc 095, and line 4 of doc 094. The expected end state is 2 modified + 2 new files, checked against a frozen list of 544 files.
- **What C checks:**
  - keyboard Enter on each button, at 1280 and 1440;
  - mouse clicks and a held Enter;
  - video opening and closing the library without moving focus;
  - the video-dock check described below;
  - regressions in the library and floating video;
  - purchase protection.
- **Ableton:** doesn't apply; this is CZABA's own keyboard rule, and no Ableton claim is made.

**Related checks I ran in the browser:** the video-dock "დაბრუნება", ✕ and ⤢ buttons do not lose focus, so that part of A-R108-SWEEP-HITS did not reproduce; C confirms it in round 110. Pan reset never loses focus either, so it stays a deferred Low.

**Advisor:** available and used twice. The second review found one mistake in my draft: one of the deliberate code breaks A runs to prove the tests work could not have failed the test I pointed it at. I added a test case (LF5b) that it does fail.

**Architecture:** the same focus-handoff pattern is now in a third component. I added this to the pending architecture checkpoint request to root as addendum (u). It doesn't block anything, and no refactor is scheduled.

**Open questions (not blocking):**
- Should Enter on an empty page area add the selected library sound (B-R107-ENTER-ON-BODY)?
- Does a Medium that is fixed in Chromium but can't be checked in Safari count as a manual check under your 2026-10-23 rule (A-R73-SAFARI)?

**Order after round 110:**
1. The regression round.
2. The C-only measurement round in the cloud for the other open Mediums.
3. T12, once no Medium or higher is open.
4. The Ableton expert review.
5. VISUAL-A.
6. The deferred Lows.
7. The final regression.
